title: matricaria maritima subsp. inodora
intro: Matricaria maritima subsp. inodora, commonly known as sea chamomile, is a subspecies of the Matricaria maritima plant, which is a perennial herb that grows in coastal areas. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to soothe skin irritations and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of sea chamomile include calming and sedative effects, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for anxiety and sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of Matricaria maritima subsp. inodora include apigenin, luteolin, and chamazulene, which are responsible for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
